releases.name: v0.2.2
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(native): roll back phantom edge when bridge rejects connect (#63) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/86
* build: pin @chromatic-com/storybook to 5.3.0 (#74) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/88
* docs: fix RtAudio→JUCE audio-backend drift (#77) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/94
* security(tone3000): don't persist refresh token in localStorage (#76) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/93
* fix(presets): don't abort applyPreset on one bad model/IR (#64) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/91
* perf(web): memoize BlockCard; stop whole-grid re-render on param change (#67) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/92
* perf(web): coalesce per-param worklet messages per frame (#78) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/90
* build: enable strict-peer-dependencies (#79) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/89
* fix(native): count loaded IRs in countActiveHeavyBlocks (#65) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/87
* Fix/066 perblock adjacency by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/98
* fix(core+web): stop reconcile storm resetting the native audio engine (#62) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/100
* fix(web+desktop): guard user NAM/IR file loads with size + type caps (#69) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/102
* fix(desktop): only load the UI from a trusted loopback URL (#71) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/103
* test(desktop): round-trip every symbol-mapped effect kind's param keys (#41) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/106
* test(web): add real-WASM integration test for the Web->WASM ABI boundary (#80) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/107
* build(core): catch WASM EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS drift before it ships (#70) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/108
* test(ui): add characterization tests for packages/ui's leaf primitives (#68) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/109
* fix(web): dispatch useAudioEngine to a single hook, not both (#44) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/111
* docs: add root AGENTS.md orientation doc for executors (#75) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/110
* fix(web): add a top-level error boundary and unhandled-rejection handler (#50) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/112
* build: add a versioning system + tag-triggered GitHub Releases (#54) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/113
* build(web): generate UI knob ranges from the core param schema (#72) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/116
* fix(web): give NativeAnalyser the frequency-domain surface the art needs (#114) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/117
* fix(desktop): apply the Input TRIM knob on the native path (#115) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/139
* chore(repo): add a one-shot setup task that also repairs the toolchain by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/140
* Fix native desktop device selection + exit-time heap corruption by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/142
* test(web): unit tests for low-coverage modules + coverage gate (#141) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.com/pauloedspinho20/OpenAxe/pull/145
* fix(desktop): Tone3000 catalog clicks and WKWebView-only text clipping (#146) by @pauloedspinho20 in https://github.
